en-US.guide.heading: How to read this page
en-US.guide.cases: What a case checks is the doc comment above it in the sources, or its own name when it carries none; the chips beside it are the behaviours {0} says break with it.
en-US.guide.passed: Passed: the case ran, and every assertion it makes held.
en-US.guide.failed: Failed: one of them did not hold, or the case panicked; its row is tinted and the line the tool printed for it is coloured in Output.
en-US.guide.ignored: Ignored: the case is marked ignored, or it needs something this machine has not got, and the reason is printed under its result.
en-US.guide.normal: A normal run reaches every target below, fails nothing, and skips only what it gives a reason for.
en-US.layers.heading: What each layer can prove
en-US.layers.nameless: the coverage document gives this target no layer
en-US.notes.layers: {0} says what each layer's cases are for and what passing them does not prove; the case counts in it are the numbers the document declares, not this run's.
en-US.notes.skipping: {0} case(s) reported skipping, and are listed above.
en-US.notes.cases.match: Every case the suite printed is listed under Cases: {0} case(s), {1} passed, {2} failed, {3} ignored, which is what the run's own result lines report.
en-US.notes.cases.mismatch: The cases listed under Cases count {0} passed, {1} failed, {2} ignored, while the run's own result lines count {3} passed, {4} failed, {5} ignored: a case line could not be read.
en-US.notes.snapshots: The page snapshots come from scripts/capture_setup_snapshots.ps1, which photographs a real setup; the checks beside each one are what that capture measured on it.
en-US.notes.nosnapshots: No page snapshots were found in target/setup-snapshots, so this report has none. scripts/capture_setup_snapshots.ps1 photographs a real setup and checks it, and needs a desktop session.
en-US.notes.setupcases: The setup-level cases build and run a real installer, so they need the runtime executables the builder embeds and skip without them; scripts/run_e2e_setup.ps1 builds those and keeps its own report.
en-US.notes.textfile: target/{0} next to this page holds the same run as plain text.
en-US.e2e.notes.what: The suite writes its own project, builds a setup, runs it, and then runs the uninstaller it deployed.
en-US.e2e.notes.stubs: NANO_INSTALLER_E2E_REQUIRE_STUBS makes a run in which every case skipped read as a failure.
en-US.e2e.notes.cases: Every case the suite printed is listed under Cases: {0} case(s), {1} passed, {2} failed, {3} ignored.
en-US.e2e.notes.snapshots: The page snapshots come from scripts/capture_setup_snapshots.ps1, which photographs a real setup and needs a desktop session; a machine without one shows none here.

安装包级用例会真的构建并运行安装包，所以需要构建器内嵌的那三个运行时，缺了就跳过；

zh-CN.guide.heading: 怎么看这一页
zh-CN.guide.cases: 用例的「检查什么」取自源码里它上方的文档注释，没有注释的按用例名读；旁边的芯片是 {0} 说会随它一起坏掉的行为。
zh-CN.guide.passed: 通过：用例跑完了，它做的每一条断言都成立。
zh-CN.guide.failed: 失败：有断言不成立，或者用例 panic；它那一行会标红，工具为它打印的原始行在「输出」里也标红。
zh-CN.guide.ignored: 忽略：用例标了 ignore，或者它需要这台机器没有的东西；原因印在它的结果下面。
zh-CN.guide.normal: 正常的一轮：下面每一个目标都跑到，没有失败，只跳过写明原因的那几条。
zh-CN.layers.heading: 各层能证明什么
zh-CN.layers.nameless: 覆盖文档没有给这个目标分层
zh-CN.notes.layers: {0} 写明每一层的用例在测什么、证明不了什么；其中的用例数是文档自己声明的数字，不是这次运行的数字。
zh-CN.notes.skipping: 有 {0} 条用例主动跳过，已列在上面。
zh-CN.notes.cases.match: 套件打印出来的每一条用例都列在「用例」一节：共 {0} 条，{1} 通过、{2} 失败、{3} 忽略，与这次运行自己的结果行一致。
zh-CN.notes.cases.mismatch: 「用例」一节统计出 {0} 通过、{1} 失败、{2} 忽略，而这次运行自己的结果行是 {3} 通过、{4} 失败、{5} 忽略：有用例行没读到。
zh-CN.notes.snapshots: 截图来自 scripts/capture_setup_snapshots.ps1 对真实安装包的拍摄；每张下面的检查项就是抓图时实测到的结果。
zh-CN.notes.nosnapshots: target/setup-snapshots 里没有截图，所以这一页没有图。scripts/capture_setup_snapshots.ps1 会拍摄并核对真实安装包，需要桌面会话。
zh-CN.notes.setupcases: 安装包级用例会真的构建并运行安装包，需要构建器内嵌的那三个运行时，缺了就跳过；scripts/run_e2e_setup.ps1 会把它们构建出来并留下自己的报告。
zh-CN.notes.textfile: 同一目录下的 target/{0} 是这次运行的纯文本版。
zh-CN.e2e.notes.what: 这套用例自己写出一份工程，构建安装包，运行它，再运行它部署出来的卸载程序。
zh-CN.e2e.notes.stubs: NANO_INSTALLER_E2E_REQUIRE_STUBS=1 让「全部跳过」的那次运行算作失败。
zh-CN.e2e.notes.cases: 套件打印出来的每一条用例都列在「用例」一节：共 {0} 条，{1} 通过、{2} 失败、{3} 忽略。
zh-CN.e2e.notes.snapshots: 截图来自 scripts/capture_setup_snapshots.ps1 对真实安装包的拍摄，需要桌面会话；没有桌面的机器这一页就没有图。
